about.guide:
Statistics|The latest draw and the statistics of all draws: frequency, overdue numbers, map and pairs. Click the latest draw for winners and prizes.
Ticket|Choose 1-12 columns and an algorithm, then press “Generate ticket”. 🔒 keeps a column, 🔄 regenerates only that one. If you really play it, press “I played it”.
My tickets|Every ticket is checked automatically as soon as its draw is out: hits, class and prize, with totals of spending and winnings.
Draws|The next draw with a countdown and the latest draws. Click a draw for winners, prizes and where they were won.
Settings|Country (how draws are shown), language, theme, price per column, automatic update and export/import of a backup.
Updating|“Update draws” brings the new results. A new version of the app is checked in Settings.
about.sources.text:
Official EuroJackpot service (eurojackpot.com): draws since 2012, winners, prizes and where they were won.
Allwyn (api.opap.gr): Greek figures since 2024 and the jackpot.
